mapper.select:
SELECT c.*, ct.city_name FROM crew c JOIN city ct ON c.city_no = ct.city_no
AND c.city_no = #{cityNo}
AND
c.crew_day LIKE CONCAT('%', #{day}, '%')
ORDER BY c.crew_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE crew SET crew_name = #{crewName}, crew_size = #{crewSize}, district_no = #{districtNo}, city_no = #{cityNo}, crew_content = #{crewContent}, crew_url = #{crewUrl}, crew_day = #{crewDay}, crew_lat = #{crewLat}, crew_lng = #{crewLng}, crew_location = #{crewLocation} WHERE crew_no = #{crewNo}
mapper.select: SELECT *, (6371 * acos( cos(radians(#{lat})) * cos(radians(crew_lat)) * cos(radians(crew_lng) - radians(#{lng})) + sin(radians(#{lat})) * sin(radians(crew_lat)) )) AS distance FROM crew HAVING distance < #{radius} ORDER BY distance
